question: For each fixed high coordinate bit r=27..39, exhaustively enumerate the same 2^27 selector indices on each N83 Koblitz, general-binary, and prime curve, preserve complete affine point bases, and bind each base for reuse at m=2..9. This stage records factor-base structure and exact point counts only; it does not measure FFD, LFD, degree of regularity, or solver cost. This amendment uses the EKS job-scoped results bucket for source reads and outputs; it preserves partial uploads as immutable content-addressed snapshots.

claims.text: For every r in 27..39 and all three curve families, enumerate all 2^27 candidate x-coordinates, retain every affine lift with both distinct signs, and validate all omitted-lift checks.
Bind each completed family/r manifest to the unchanged base used for m=2..9.
No FFD, LFD, degree-of-regularity, PDP-solver-cost, subgroup, or ECDLP claim is made by this enumeration stage.

amendments.reason: The r=27 attempt r1 failed before the factor-base producer started because the EKS worker role could not list the setec-astronomy-artifacts source bucket. This amendment places runtime assets and immutable outputs under the job-scoped isolab-results prefix and uses exact-key aws s3 cp operations. No factor-base data from r1 existed.

The r=27 attempt r2 reached DeadlineExceeded at 2026-10-31T03:30:10Z while unscheduled. Its final results listing contains only the ten source-v2 objects and no point output. This amendment changes only the r=27 immutable attempt binding to 03 and preserves the full r=27..39, three-family, all-shard enumeration and all instrument/resource choices.

The r=27 attempt r3 scheduled and its wrapper started, but exact-key source retrieval used the Pod-scoped ISOLAB_RESULTS_URI and therefore requested a nonexistent r3/<pod-uid>/source-v3/BUNDLE_FORMAT.json key. The verified source-v3 bundle was at the Job-root prefix; the producer did not start and no point data was produced. This amendment assigns fresh attempt04 and fixes source location to exact keys under the new Job-root source-v4 prefix; output remains under the per-Pod ISOLAB_RESULTS_URI. Mathematical scope, source, binary, image, resources, shards, curve families and m-reuse are unchanged.

freeze.protocol_digest: Exact protocol bytes are hashed in protocol-factor-base-variants-v5.sha256 and included in each run manifest. This amendment changes only fresh-attempt binding and launch argument/source URI handling; factor-base domain, candidate count, curve families, shard count, and reuse contract are unchanged.

extensions.model_readiness: Enumeration only. Train a base-ranking model only after matched PDP systems and exact or explicitly censored Dreg evidence are available; validation folds must group by coordinate-bit/base ID.
extensions.data_preservation: Never delete or overwrite local or S3 attempts; retries use a new attempt identifier and retain partial outputs.
extensions.image_contract: The existing UID-1000 isolab/tasks base image; the factor_base binary, runner, protocol and design are downloaded from the immutable S3 source prefix into /work/source before execution. The runner writes to the unique per-bit S3 attempt prefix.
extensions.source_prefix_rule: Immutable source-v4 code/assets are downloaded by exact key from Job root runs/n83-fb-variants-r27-20261031-r4/source-v4/; protocol-v5 and its source index are downloaded by exact key from the new Job root runs/n83-fb-variants-r27-20261031-r5/source-v5/. Derive Job root from Pod-scoped ISOLAB_RESULTS_URI by removing the final /<podUID>/ segment. Pass the derived Job-root URI as runner argument 4 and protocol path as argument 5.
extensions.output_upload_contract: Every payload state is copied to snapshots/<sha256(relative-path)>/<sha256(exact-bytes)>; uploaded states are not overwritten. A final content-addressed index maps file names, lengths and hashes to object keys.
extensions.source_access_contract: EKS worker role cannot ListBucket on setec-astronomy-artifacts. Runtime assets therefore live under the current job’s allowed ISOLAB_RESULTS_URI; the worker downloads exact objects with aws s3 cp.
extensions.launch_argument_contract: run-base-variant-v2.sh <binary> <coordinate_bit> <fresh_output_dir> <job_root_results_uri> <protocol_path>; never pass raw Pod-scoped ISOLAB_RESULTS_URI as the protocol path.
